description: Search products across openFDA, DSLD, INKEEDecoder, RxNorm, and DailyMed. Start free text with type 'name'; use 'brand' deliberately for brand-only search, which covers fewer sources. If a full product name has no matches, retry type 'name' with only the brand (Natrol) or only the ingredient (melatonin); compare brand, variant, strength, and dosage form before selecting a record. Use ingredient, barcode, or ndc when appropriate, and pass category medication/supplement/cosmetic when known. Returns evidence-grouped entities with original records, confirmed links, source-attributed conflicts, unconfirmed candidates, and per-entity nextSteps. A product RxCUI or shared name alone does not merge products. For source+id use drugdata_get_product instead. Default searches return lightweight evidence without identity resolution; resolve_identities: true opts in to enrichment of at most five entities, concurrency three, within the shared 45-second default deadline. Read partial, coverage, and sources (status ok/error/timeout); completed results survive a timeout. One page applies to every source and re-queries all of them; each source's hasMore is independent. Selectively fetch supplied URLs only when more page content is needed. No matches is normal, not an error.

category.description: Optional category filter: 'medication', 'supplement', or 'cosmetic'. Only sources about that category are queried.

page.description: Page number for the fan-out, starting at 1. One page applies to every source and re-queries all of them.

query.description: The search value, as text or an identifier.

resolve_identities.description: Opt in to identity enrichment for at most five entities, concurrency three. Default false: return lightweight search evidence and resolution nextSteps.

response_format.description: Text format: 'markdown' for a readable grouped report, or 'json' for the structured result serialized as JSON.

type.description: What to search by: 'name' for a product name, 'brand' for a brand name, 'ingredient' for an ingredient name, 'barcode' for a UPC/EAN, or 'ndc' for an NDC.
